ABCD is a trapezoid.

[Image: Trapezoid ABCD]

Another trapezoid, GHIJ (not shown), is congruent (the same size and shape) to ABCD. Angles G and J each measure 70°. Which of these could be true?

options.label: B
options.text: Angle H is a right angle.

options.label: C
options.text: All sides of GHIJ are the same length.

options.label: D
options.text: The perimeter of GHIJ is 3 times the perimeter of ABCD.

options.label: E
options.text: The area of GHIJ is less than the area of ABCD.

figure_description: An isosceles trapezoid ABCD with horizontal base AD along the bottom and shorter horizontal side BC along the top. Vertex A is at the bottom left, B is at the top left, C is at the top right, and D is at the bottom right. The interior angle at vertex A is labeled 70°, and the interior angle at vertex D is labeled 70°.
